title: Step 6: A Tiny Server Loop
story: Real stores speak a command language. Give yours one.
goal: Write run(kv, line) for SET, GET, DEL and INCR, and loop over stdin printing each answer.
starter: # write run(), then loop over input()
hints: Split the line into at most three parts: command, key, value.
Unknown commands answer ERR unknown command.
socratic: What should this new piece take in, and give back?
Which earlier piece can you reuse?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: how does this checkpoint build on the last one?
